{{Short description|German mathematician}}
'''L. C. Schnürlein''' (''fl.'' nineteenth century) was a German [[mathematician]] and [[educator]].

Having studied under [[Carl Friedrich Gauss]], he became a teacher at the gymnasium in [[Hof, Germany|Hof]], tutoring, among others, [[Carl Culmann]] and [[Philipp Ludwig von Seidel]].
